latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of nano-banana-image skill.

- Generate and edit AI images via AceDataCloud NanoBanana (Gemini-based) API.
- Supports both standard (`nano-banana`) and high-quality (`nano-banana-pro`) models.
- Enables text-to-image and image editing workflows using natural language prompts.
- No mask needed for editing; simply describe desired changes.
- Returns direct image URLs with flexible aspect ratios.
- Requires ACEDATACLOUD_API_TOKEN for authentication.
